# CipherVerse

> Professional, Zero-Knowledge Cybersecurity & Cryptography Web Suite

CipherVerse is a high-performance, client-side web application offering 40+ interactive cryptographic tools, malware triage utilities, binary forensics analyzers, and historical cipher machine simulators.
All computations run 100% locally in the browser via the Web Crypto API, WebAssembly, and native JavaScript implementations - no private keys, passwords, or encrypted payloads are ever uploaded to a server.

## Canonical Resources
- [Interactive Workspace](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/): Full browser-based cryptographic suite.
- [Cryptography Blog](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blog): In-depth tutorials, mathematical breakdowns, and security teardowns.
- [XML Sitemap](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable route directory.
- [API Explorer](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/api-explorer): REST API documentation and endpoints.

(10 min read)
- [Atbash Cipher: Ancient Biblical Cryptography, Involution Symmetry & Modern Decoders](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blog/atbash-cipher): An exhaustive academic breakdown of the Atbash Cipher: ancient Hebrew scribal origins in the Book of Jeremiah, involution symmetry f(f(x)) = x, affine cipher equivalence in ℤ₂₆, mirror frequency analysis, and runnable Python implementations. (8 min read)
- [Affine Cipher: Modular Multiplicative Inverses, Coprimality & Algebraic Cryptanalysis](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blog/affine-cipher): An exhaustive mathematical breakdown of the Affine Cipher: linear congruences in ℤ₂₆, the coprimality condition gcd(a, 26) = 1, calculating modular inverses with the Extended Euclidean Algorithm, and two-point algebraic cryptanalysis. (9 min read)
- [Rail Fence Cipher: The Complete Guide to Zig-Zag Transposition & Cryptanalysis](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blog/rail-fence-cipher): An exhaustive educational breakdown of the Rail Fence Cipher: transposition vs. substitution, triangular wave periodicity P = 2(d - 1), worked zig-zag matrix traces, preserved frequency distributions, anagramming, and runnable Python auto-crackers. (8 min read)
- [Bifid Cipher: Polybius Fractionation, Delastelle's Breakthrough & Modern Diffusion](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blog/bifid-cipher): An exhaustive educational breakdown of the Bifid Cipher: Felix Delastelle's 1901 invention, Polybius square coordinate decomposition, horizontal stream fractionation, Claude Shannon's concept of diffusion, and runnable Python auto-solvers. - [Bacon's Cipher & Steganography: The Complete Binary Encoding & Cryptanalysis Guide](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blog/bacon-cipher): An exhaustive educational breakdown of Sir Francis Bacon's 1605 bilateral cipher: information theory principles (ceil(log2(26)) = 5), 24-letter vs. 26-letter alphabets, typeface steganography (Font A/B), worked carrier trace matrices, and standalone Python auto-steganography suite. (9 min read)
- [Simple Monoalphabetic Substitution Cipher: Key Spaces, Frequency Analysis & Algorithmic Solvers](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blog/substitution-cipher): An exhaustive academic breakdown of the monoalphabetic substitution cipher: the 26! (4.03 × 10²⁶) permutation key space, Al-Kindi's 9th-century discovery of frequency analysis, n-gram statistical cryptanalysis, hill-climbing optimization, and runnable Python auto-solvers. (9 min read)

(7 min read)
- [Steganography Masterclass: How to Conceal Secrets in Digital Images and Audio](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blog/steganography-guide): A practical, mathematical guide to modern steganography: LSB spatial embedding, discrete cosine transforms (DCT), high-frequency audio phase encoding, and forensic steganalysis detection. (8 min read)

## Security Suites & Domain Directories

### [Classical Ciphers](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical)
Caesar, Vigenere, Atbash, and more

- [Caesar Cipher Decoder, Encoder & ROT13 Solver](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical/caesar): Free online Caesar Cipher encoder, decoder, and brute-force solver. Shift text by any key instantly with detailed letter frequency analysis.
- [Vigenere Cipher Encoder, Decoder & Key Solver](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical/vigenere): Encrypt and decrypt messages using the polyalphabetic Vigenere Cipher. Includes automatic keyword analysis and tabular visualization.
- [Atbash Cipher Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical/atbash): Fast online Atbash Cipher tool to substitute alphabet letters in reverse order (A to Z, B to Y) with instant reciprocal encryption and decryption.
- [Baconian Cipher Encoder & Steganographic Decoder](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical/bacon): Encode and decode hidden messages using Francis Bacon's 5-letter binary steganographic cipher system with 24-letter and 26-letter alphabet options.
- [Bifid Cipher Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical/bifid): Encrypt and decrypt using the Bifid Cipher, combining Polybius square substitution with vertical transposition fractionation.
- [Affine Cipher Solver & Mathematical Decoder](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical/affine): Online Affine Cipher tool to perform mathematical substitution encryption and cryptanalysis using linear modular arithmetic formulas E(x) = (ax + b) mod 26.
- [A1Z26 Cipher & Number Substitution Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical/a1z26): Convert text to numbers and numbers back to text instantly with the A1Z26 letter-number substitution converter, custom separators, and error handling.
- [Rail Fence Cipher](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical/rail-fence): Online Rail Fence Cipher calculator. Encrypt and decrypt messages using multi-rail zigzag transposition paths with interactive rail offset controls.
- [Monoalphabetic Substitution Cipher Solver](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/classical/substitution): Solve monoalphabetic substitution ciphers with custom alphabet key mappings, real-time letter frequency analysis, and automated pattern substitution.

### [Symmetric Crypto](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric)
AES, DES, Blowfish, RC4, XOR

- [AES Encryption & Decryption Online (128/256-bit)](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/aes): Secure online Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) calculator supporting CBC, GCM, CTR modes with cryptographic key generation and authentication tags.
- [DES (Data Encryption Standard) Online Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/des): Explore the Data Encryption Standard (DES) with interactive encryption, decryption, CBC/ECB mode selection, and 16-round subkey schedule visualization.
- [Triple DES (3DES / TDEA) Encryption Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/3des): Online Triple DES (3DES/TDEA) calculator supporting 2-key and 3-key EDE modes with custom IVs and padding configurations for legacy cryptographic inspection.
- [RC2 Block Cipher Encryption & Decryption](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/rc2): Encrypt and decrypt data using Ron Rivest's RC2 variable key-size block cipher with customizable effective key bit lengths and CBC/ECB mode options.
- [RC4 Stream Cipher Generator & Decrypter](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/rc4): Generate RC4 keystream sequences and encrypt or decrypt arbitrary data online with interactive Key Scheduling (KSA) and PRGA state array inspections.
- [RC4-Drop Stream Cipher & Keystream Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/rc4-drop): Enhanced RC4-Drop implementation discarding initial N keystream bytes to eliminate Fluhrer-Mantin-Shamir (FMS) weak key vulnerabilities and state biases.
- [Blowfish Encryption & Decryption Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/blowfish): Encrypt and decrypt data using Bruce Schneier's 64-bit Blowfish block cipher with variable key lengths up to 448 bits, custom IVs, and mode selections.
- [SM4 National Standard Block Cipher Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/sm4): Encrypt and decrypt data using the Chinese National Standard SM4 128-bit block cipher (GB/T 32907-2016) with CBC and ECB mode configurations.
- [CipherSaber-2 Key Stream Encryption Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/ciphersaber2): Encrypt and decrypt using the CipherSaber-2 cryptographic protocol, featuring 10-byte initialization vectors and configurable RC4 state array mixing rounds.
- [XOR Cipher & Multi-Byte Key Bruteforce Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/symmetric/xor): Encrypt, decrypt, and crack single-byte and multi-byte repeating XOR ciphers with automated Hamming distance key-size detection and English frequency analysis.

### [Asymmetric Crypto](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/asymmetric)
RSA, DSA key generation and operations

- [RSA Key Generator, Encryption & Signatures](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/asymmetric/rsa): Online RSA tool to generate PEM keypairs (1024, 2048, 4096 bit), encrypt messages, decrypt ciphertexts, sign, and verify signatures.
- [DSA Key Generator & Digital Signature Algorithm](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/asymmetric/dsa): Generate FIPS 186 Digital Signature Algorithm (DSA) key parameters, sign cryptographic digests, and verify digital signatures against public verification keys.

### [Hashing & KDFs](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/hashing)
SHA, MD5, HMAC, PBKDF2, Scrypt, bcrypt

- [SHA-256 & Cryptographic Hash Generator](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/hashing): Calculate cryptographic hashes (SHA-256, SHA-512, MD5, SHA-3), HMAC signatures, and run PBKDF2, Scrypt, and bcrypt key derivation functions instantly.

### [Encoding & Decoding](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/encoding)
Base64, Hex, URL, Binary, Morse

- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder Online](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/encoding/base64): Instant online Base64 text and binary data encoder and decoder with UTF-8, URL-safe Base64URL, and hex output support for secure data transmission.
- [Hexadecimal (Hex) Encoder & Decoder Online](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/encoding/hex): Convert plain text to Hex bytes and decode Hex strings to readable ASCII text instantly with custom byte delimiters, prefix formatting, and validation.
- [URL Percent Encoder & Decoder Online](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/encoding/url): Encode special characters into percent-encoded URI strings and decode encoded query parameters safely with full UTF-8 and component encoding support.
- [Text to Binary & Binary to Text Converter](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/encoding/binary): Convert ASCII and UTF-8 text into 8-bit binary numbers (0s and 1s) and decode binary byte streams instantly with customizable spacing and bit formats.
- [Morse Code Translator](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/encoding/morse): Translate text into International Morse Code dots and dashes with real-time audio playback, custom WPM speeds, visual flashing, and audio download options.

### [Certificates & TLS](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/certificates)
X.509 parsing, TLS analysis

- [X.509 SSL/TLS Certificate Parser Online](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/certificates/x509): Parse X.509 PEM and DER certificates to inspect subject, issuer, serial numbers, validity windows, SAN extensions, and extract public key parameters instantly.
- [TLS Protocol & Cipher Suite Inspection Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/certificates/tls): Analyze SSL/TLS handshake sequences, cipher suite negotiations, protocol versions (TLS 1.2/1.3), and forward secrecy parameters for secure web connections.
- [SSL Certificate Fingerprint Calculator](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/certificates/fingerprint): Compute SHA-1, SHA-256, and MD5 thumbprints for X.509 SSL/TLS certificates instantly to verify host identity and validate pin headers in your application.

### [Blockchain](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blockchain)
Bitcoin, Ethereum, Merkle trees

- [Bitcoin Address Validator & Script Inspector](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blockchain/bitcoin): Validate Bitcoin legacy (P2PKH), SegWit (P2SH), and native Bech32/Taproot addresses with Base58Check and BCH error-detecting checksum verifications online.
- [Ethereum Address Validator & EIP-55 Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blockchain/ethereum): Verify Ethereum 0x hex wallet addresses and test EIP-55 mixed-case Keccak-256 checksum validity online to prevent costly mistyped transaction errors.
- [Merkle Tree Construction & Visual Proof Generator](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blockchain/merkle): Build interactive Merkle Trees from transaction hashes, calculate the cryptographic root hash, and verify audit path inclusion proofs with visual graphs.
- [Wallet Import Format (WIF) Private Key Encoder](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/blockchain/wif): Encode and decode Bitcoin 256-bit ECDSA private keys into compressed and uncompressed Wallet Import Format (WIF) with Base58Check checksum validation.

### [Steganography](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/steganography)
Text, image, and audio steganography

- [Zero-Width Text Steganography Encoder & Decoder](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/steganography/text): Conceal hidden secret messages inside ordinary plain text using zero-width invisible unicode characters (ZWSP, ZWNJ) undetectable to standard text viewers.
- [Image Steganography Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/steganography/image): Embed and extract hidden encrypted messages inside PNG and JPEG image pixels using Least Significant Bit (LSB) encoding with AES encryption and passphrases.
- [Audio Steganography Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/steganography/audio): Embed hidden secret messages into uncompressed WAV audio sample data using Least Significant Bit (LSB) encoding while preserving acoustic fidelity.

### [File Forensics](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/file-forensics)
File hashing, entropy, randomness tests

- [Single File Hash Generator & Verifier](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/file-forensics/hash): Calculate cryptographic digests (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256) for local files directly in your browser using Web Crypto API without uploading any bytes to a server.
- [Multi-Algorithm Concurrent File Hasher](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/file-forensics/multi-hash): Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and RIPEMD-160 checksums simultaneously in a single stream pass directly in your browser for rapid digital forensics.
- [Shannon File Entropy Analyzer & Visualization](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/file-forensics/entropy): Calculate Shannon entropy distributions across binary files to detect packed executables, compressed sections, or hidden encrypted payloads with visual graphs.
- [Cryptographic Randomness Test Suite](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/file-forensics/randomness): Evaluate random number generator outputs with NIST-inspired Chi-square tests, byte distribution histograms, and serial correlation tests for high entropy.

### [Malware Analysis](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/malware-analysis)
Hash analysis, TLSH, PE analysis

- [Malware File Hash Lookup & Threat Triage](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/malware-analysis/hash): Generate and query MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 file hashes against threat intelligence databases to quickly triage malware samples and detect malicious binaries.
- [TLSH Fuzzy Hash & Malware Comparator](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/malware-analysis/tlsh): Calculate Trend Micro Locality Sensitive Hashes (TLSH) and compute distance scores to detect polymorphic malware family variants and binary similarities.
- [PE Header Parser & EXE Section Inspector](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/malware-analysis/pe): Parse Windows PE32/PE32+ executable headers, section tables (.text, .data, .rsrc), import/export directory tables, and compile timestamps in your browser.

### [Utilities](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/utilities)
Password strength, salt, JWT, checksums

- [Password Strength & Entropy Calculator](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/utilities/password): Evaluate password entropy (bits), estimate brute-force cracking time, and detect common dictionary vulnerability patterns.
- [JWT (JSON Web Token) HMAC Signer & Verifier](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/utilities/jwt): Sign and verify JSON Web Tokens (JWT) online using HS256, HS384, or HS512 HMAC secret keys with real-time decoded header and payload JSON inspections.
- [Cryptographic Salt & Token Generator](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/utilities/salt): Generate high-entropy cryptographically secure random salts, IVs, and session tokens in Hex, Base64, and C-array formats using browser Web Crypto CSPRNG.
- [Fletcher-16 Checksum & Integrity Tool](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/utilities/fletcher16): Calculate 16-bit Fletcher checksums online with modular block arithmetic to verify data integrity and detect transmission errors in digital data.

### [Historical Machines](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/historical)
Enigma, Bombe, Typex simulators

- [Enigma Machine Simulator (I, M3, M4) Online](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/historical/enigma): Authentic 3-rotor and 4-rotor Enigma machine simulator. Configure rotors, ring settings, reflector, and plugboard (Steckerbrett).
- [Alan Turing Bombe Crib Analysis Simulator](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/historical/bombe): Interactive simulation of Alan Turing's Bombe electromechanical machine used at Bletchley Park to break Enigma rotor keys.
- [British Typex Cipher Machine Simulator](https://cipherverse.cybrito.tech/historical/typex): Simulate the British WWII Typex cipher machine with authentic multi-rotor stepping mechanisms, plugboard options, and statutory transposition decoding.
